additional_info.subject: ID0415742-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002424] Outlets OOO CRM:00642002188
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
Regarding the reported issue, we have inspected the charger on SCB and identified some anomalies with the state monitor. Therefore, we recommend a site visit to troubleshoot the StateMonitor_KF14, as the schematic nomenclature differs from the respective SCB error flags.
Please follow the steps provided in the attached document and refer to the points below:
Check the areas marked in red for possible loose wiring, all wirings related to state monitor and power converters.
If all the wiring is secure and configuration is ok, then need to be replace but check all the connections of the KF14 module before considering its replacement.
Additionally, please refer to the attached knowledge article links for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_State Monitor KF13_Fastshutdown Fault Phase - Dynamics 365
Also, for following error
This problem indicates that there might be an obstruction preventing the fan from rotating. Additionally, please inspect the wiring, as it's possible that the fans are unable to provide feedback. Consider planning for an auxiliary fan replacement to perform an on-site check; it's possible that the fan is damaged.
We need site intervention to check for the reason of the Deadlock, If any of the wire or some obstacle obstructing the fan (GQ2 and GQ3) functioning.
Regarding GQ2 Fan, we need to check for the 24V, 0V power supply to the fan and check the Output Couple QA31, Connections (continuity) at XD9.
Further for GQ3, we need to check Voltages of 24v and 0v are available, Functioning of QA30, Continuity at XD7.
Please find below attached knowledge article link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Fans, wiring,GQ3, QA31_Fans_GQ2-3 - Dynamics 365
